id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

activeCount.description:
Denotes the number of times a given `ProcessProfiler` has been {@link ProcessProfiler#start}ed, but not
{@link ProcessProfiler#stop}ped. If non-zero, profiling is occurring.

title:
Type that supports measuring a process's memory usage over a period of time. The {@link #id} denotes the PID of
the process being profiled.
name: ProcessProfiler
